description: Equity style factors from the Ken French Data Library (market-intelligence F4). FF5 (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA) + Momentum (MOM), daily, free, no key, back to 1926. Used to (1) give scenariogen a 'style:MOM' driver so 'momentum crash' -- a positioning-unwind co-move a name-level covariance model structurally cannot see -- becomes a first-class authorable scenario, and (2) regress the book's factor returns onto real style exposures. See docs/design/AITrade_market_intelligence_design.md FINDING 4.

ken_french.name: Ken French Data Library — daily style factors
ken_french.description: Two ZIP archives, each a single CSV with a multi-line text header/footer and YYYYMMDD daily rows in PERCENT. Parsed in memory (ZIP -> BytesIO -> zipfile), never extracted to disk (dual-mode trap 1). Merged on date into one factors CSV, values kept in the source's percent unit; factor_history converts to decimal.
